reviewer: Claude（Claude Code 会话）：faster-whisper small.en 与 medium.en 两档逐词转写交叉核对，并对照本地抽帧；未人工听音

foreground_english.en: On the second note, I was here two years ago when I won,
foreground_english.zh: 还有一件事，两年前我在这里夺冠，

foreground_english.en: and I was like, what a great anniversary gift for my wife.
foreground_english.zh: 我想，这份纪念日礼物真不错。

foreground_english.en: And yeah, it's funny, because dates usually change,
foreground_english.zh: 有意思的是，日期一般会变，

foreground_english.en: but today, Sunday, again is the anniversary,
foreground_english.zh: 可今天这个星期天，又是纪念日，

foreground_english.en: so I thought, come on, do it one more time.

review_note: 梅德韦杰夫颁奖致辞原声，两档一致（medium 198.40–225.26）。德约随后致辞也说 Happy anniversary to your wife（644.12），互相印证。段尾 225.4 在下一句（231.66）之前。
